instruction: In the original LIBERO Object task zero pick the alphabet soup can with the blue ALPHABET SOUP label and orange pasta letters and place it in the woven basket. Use local Qwen to identify candidates formed from calibrated RGB-D foreground regions above the known floor plane. Execute observe detect identify segment estimate check before movement. Route explicitly on found grasp and placement checks and abort on missing geometry. No proxy color identity rules or simulator pose fallback. Seeds zero through nine select the corresponding official saved initial states of this one task.

skills.name: perceiving-proxy-objects
skills.description: Local Qwen identification and native RGB-D foreground geometry
skills.instructions: Detect proposes up to six largest RGB-D foreground regions compatible with the declared can or basket dimensions above the known floor plane. Depth discontinuities separate objects that touch in the image. These shape gates do not assign identities. identify_target selects the actual alphabet soup can and identify_container selects the woven basket using local Qwen. The chosen masks feed metric depth reconstruction. Abort if either object is absent ambiguous occluded or geometry is rejected. No hidden object pose or simulator segmentation fallback. At most two model calls per episode.

skills.name: grasping-direct-ik
skills.description: Open align descend close and lift with verified physical grasping
skills.instructions: Use the upstream skill guidance but only the deployed aliases below. The binding supplies scene dependent poses and checks holds. Do not invent perception or cuRobo tools. Lift may be included here or in a separate subgraph using this skill.

skills.name: transporting-objects
skills.description: Transport a verified held object into the basket and release
skills.instructions: The deployed actions resolve poses from the scene. Require lift before transport then position release retract and settle. No direct coordinate editing or physics changes are available.

actions.name: position_for_release

actions.name: release_object
actions.description: Open and verify release

actions.name: retract_from_basket
actions.description: Retract clear of the basket after release

actions.name: settle_release
actions.description: Wait for settling and verify task containment

actions.name: check_placement
actions.description: Route on the unchanged containment and release predicate

limitations: Native LIBERO Object task zero only not a whole suite evaluation
Ten official saved initial states zero through nine are reused for refinement and are not held out
Local Qwen identifies RGB-D foreground regions with a six candidate and two call budget
Known floor plane and upright 80 mm can height remain geometry priors
Actual simulator grasp contacts and the official goal predicate verify results but never choose motion targets
One bounded worker with at most one thousand control steps
